title: A Simon submanifold is a Borel set (local closedness and Lindelöf)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, r ∈ ℕ∞ and M ⊆ ℝᴺ with IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝⁿ) r M. That is, 1 ≤ r, and every y ∈ M lies in W for some V ⊆ ℝⁿ, W ⊆ ℝᴺ and ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ with IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ: V and W are open, ψ is C^r on V, ψ is injective on V, ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(x) is injective for x ∈ V. Then M is a Borel subset of ℝᴺ (MeasurableSet M).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M
